answer_1.quote: The purpose of controlled text generation is to modify the output of the language models with a pregiven attribute, so that the final output conforms to the attribute ... We evaluate the improved attribute combination strategy in both single and multiple control scenarios ... experiments on toxicity reduction on /pol/ dataset and sentiment transition on IMDB movie review dataset.
answer_1.outputs: Controlled text that satisfies specified attributes such as low toxicity, positive or negative sentiment, fluency, or child's tone.

answer_2.quote: The metrics picked in this setting are Toxicity Score (which measures the virulent degree by Perspective API) and PPL (which estimates generation consistency according to perplexity calculation). ... we also report sentiment scores.
